# Pipelines removed before launch

21 of the original 49 pipelines stay removed because they cannot produce a correct result today. (Three others, `landcover_change`, `road_extraction` and `landslide_detection`, came back once a real implementation existed.) Asking for one raises an error that quotes the reason below.

- **`air_quality_index`**: It was never implemented (needs Sentinel-5P NO2/aerosol data, which no PyGeoFetch provider offers). An uncalibrated proxy under this name could be read as health guidance.
- **`aquaculture_mapping`**: It flagged any rectangular water body by bounding-box fill ratio; reservoirs and lakes were false positives and it was never validated.
- **`canopy_height`**: CHMv2Model builds an untrained decoder (no canopy-height weights exist in the package), so heights were random; the pipeline also reported success when the model returned an error.
- **`carbon_estimation`**: Carbon was 50 x NDVI^2 x 0.47 with an invented constant; NDVI saturates in dense vegetation, so the numbers were not carbon estimates. Needs field-biomass calibration or a biomass product.
- **`construction_progress`**: It compared two land-cover maps that were both the same static ESA WorldCover 2021 product, so it reported 0% change whatever the imagery showed. Needs a date-specific classifier (trained model) to bring back.
- **`crop_type_mapping`**: It ran a neural network with no trained weights, so the output was random (two identical runs disagreed on ~38% of pixels). Use crop_monitoring with your own checkpoint.
- **`crop_yield_forecast`**: It produced a peak-NDVI map, not a yield; the 'forecast' was mean NDVI times a number you typed. Use vegetation_indices.
- **`dust_storm_tracking`**: A blue-reflectance/NDVI heuristic with an arbitrary threshold that cannot tell dust from cloud, smoke, snow or harvest. Needs aerosol data (Sentinel-5P / MODIS AOD).
- **`forest_fire`**: A duplicate of wildfire_severity (dNBR burn severity); it never detected active fire. Use wildfire_severity.
- **`infrastructure_monitoring`**: A generic change detector backed by an untrained model, with a fallback that always flagged exactly 10% of pixels. Use change_detection.
- **`irrigation_detection`**: It returned a water mask (NDWI), which is not irrigation. Use water_bodies.
- **`mangrove_mapping`**: It compared two land-cover maps that were both the same static ESA WorldCover 2021 product, so it reported 0% change whatever the imagery showed. Needs a date-specific classifier (trained model) to bring back.
- **`mine_detection`**: It compared two land-cover maps that were both the same static ESA WorldCover 2021 product, so it reported 0% change whatever the imagery showed. Needs a date-specific classifier (trained model) to bring back.
- **`ocean_ship_detection`**: It ran an everyday-photo (COCO) detector on 10 m satellite pixels, where a ship spans a few pixels and a car is smaller than one, so detections were not meaningful. Needs a detector trained on high-resolution imagery.
- **`oil_spill_detection`**: A fixed -18 dB threshold marks every calm water surface (low wind, lakes, rivers) as a candidate; it cannot be validated without labelled SAR slicks and wind data.
- **`parking_occupancy`**: It ran an everyday-photo (COCO) detector on 10 m satellite pixels, where a ship spans a few pixels and a car is smaller than one, so detections were not meaningful. Needs a detector trained on high-resolution imagery.
- **`pipeline_leak_detection`**: The crop_health NDVI-drop computation under another name; vegetation stress is not evidence of a leak.
- **`port_monitoring`**: It ran an everyday-photo (COCO) detector on 10 m satellite pixels, where a ship spans a few pixels and a car is smaller than one, so detections were not meaningful. Needs a detector trained on high-resolution imagery.
- **`powerline_extraction`**: It flagged any elongated gap in forest (roads, firebreaks, pipelines) at 10 m, where lines and towers are not visible.
- **`reef_bleaching`**: Brightness change over shallow water is dominated by tide, turbidity and sun glint, not bleaching; it was never validated against reef surveys.
- **`tree_species`**: It always returned failure: no species classifier exists. Train one and run it with your own weights.
